audit_provenance.workflow_name: Adaptive Policy Learning Study 3 Temporal Audit

temporal_split.split_rule: Stable source order after raw-position-1 filtering; train_n=floor(0.70*n).
temporal_split.boundary_tie_rule: Hard fail if the last training and first evaluation timestamps are equal.

training_only_qualification_after_merge.authorization: After this lock is merged, Study 3 may run a training-only reward-model qualification using only the 1,811,697 frozen BTS training rows and their clicks. BTS evaluation clicks, Random reference clicks, OPE estimates, challenger values, and promotion decisions remain forbidden until a successful qualification is separately frozen and execution is explicitly authorized.
training_only_qualification_after_merge.reward_model: Replicate Study 2: scikit-learn LogisticRegression with solver=newton-cholesky, pure L2 regularization, C=1, l1_ratio=0, fit_intercept=true, tol=1e-4, max_iter=100, class_weight=null.
training_only_qualification_after_merge.features: Replicate Study 2 training-only preprocessing and feature construction, adapted only to the frozen 46-action women catalog.
training_gate: no numerical fallback, Hessian instability, ill-conditioned, or singular warning
training_only_qualification_after_merge.failure_rule: Any training-gate failure terminates this Study 3 qualification attempt before evaluation outcomes are loaded. No solver, tolerance, regularization, feature, or iteration-budget change is authorized within the attempt.

scientific_boundary: This lock records only the exact outcome-blind temporal boundary and action-support audit. No click value from BTS evaluation or Random reference has been parsed, and no reward mean, OPE estimate, challenger value, bootstrap interval, or promotion decision has been computed.
next_gate: Merge this exact temporal lock, then execute Study 3 training-only qualification. Freeze a successful qualification before authorizing any evaluation-period or Random-reference outcome access.
